theEqualityTest.name: namedCorpusNotAuthored equals live G12 v4
theEqualityTest.detail: Compared with == against live harness.DR-G12.doctor-purge.preview.v4: twelve members, order preserved, each character-equal — FC-RO, FC-NC, FC-NN, FC-SCHEMA, FC-D9, FC-REDACT, FC-MODE, FC-CONSENT, FC-POSTREPORT, FC-DEGRADED, FC-HOSTILE, FC-REMEDIATION.
theEqualityTest.classesConsistency: The twelve classes[].id values equal that same list in order, and memberVerbatim equals id for every one of the twelve. Class count is twelve.
theEqualityTest.sourceShape: Live G12 v4 has NO namedCorpusClasses object — namedCorpusNotAuthored is the entire corpus surface in the source, a flat list of twelve ids. This is the structural difference from the G20 and G22 catalogs, whose sources carried per-class objects with exactByteIntent, passProperty and slashJoiner. Here there is no richer per-class content in the source to omit, so carrying the twelve ids with a NOT-AUTHORED marker each is the complete carry rather than a thin one. I checked this specifically because a minimal per-class shape is what a source-fidelity gap would look like.

attackResults.attack: OBL-G12-HARNESS-SPEC is closed as recorded at D-164
attackResults.evidence: This is the sharpest hazard in the dispatch and the catalog navigates it deliberately. Measured all three joins: v2, the artifact D-164 recorded, carries OBL-G12-HARNESS-SPEC at leftoverDesign TRUE; v3 and v4 flip it to FALSE. All three read reviewStatus AWAITING-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW, and COORD's last decision is D-166, so neither v3 nor v4 is recorded. The catalog cites v2 by digest 874af09a with recording D-164 and states 'OBL-G12-HARNESS-SPEC remains leftover-design on the recorded join. Later unrecorded successors are not this catalog's subject.' Citing v3 or v4 instead would have imported a leftoverDesign-false standing that no decision has recorded — precisely what the instruction forbids — and the catalog picks the recorded join and says why. doesNot repeats 'Does not close OBL-G12-HARNESS-SPEC as recorded at D-164.'

notCharged.whyNotCharged: It is a sibling of the corpus list rather than part of it, and the catalog's declared job is namedCorpusNotAuthored, which is carried == equal. This is the same line I drew when declining to require namedCorpusNote from the G22 catalog, and drawing it consistently is what produced the finding against the G20 v1 catalog, where the omission fell inside the class object. Recorded so a later cycle can carry it if the coordinator prefers.

verdictStatement: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX. The equality test passes by ==: namedCorpusNotAuthored carries the twelve live G12 v4 members in order, each character-equal, and the twelve classes[].id values equal that same list with memberVerbatim equal to id throughout. No FC identifier is invented — the set difference against the live list is empty, and the only other FC token in the file is FC-C1 appearing solely as an exclusion. No D9 code is minted: every D9 occurrence is either the live class name FC-D9, carried as a member id exactly as the dispatch anticipates, or a prohibition, and the artifact makes the distinction express. FC-C1 and BLK-1..BLK-4 appear only in whatIsNotAuthored. All cited digests measure equal with zero mismatches, recordedInputs.HEAD agrees with the top-level head and live HEAD, required-now is 26, no DR-G* row is added, and the subject did not move. The handling of OBL-G12-HARNESS-SPEC deserves specific credit: I measured that the D-164-recorded join v2 holds it at leftoverDesign true while the unrecorded v3 and v4 successors flip it to false, and the catalog cites v2 by digest and states that later unrecorded successors are not its subject — the one citation choice that avoids importing an unrecorded closure. Four further refutations of my own — a thin per-class shape, overstated cited standings, FC-REMEDIATION misrepresented as a live supplier, and decorative per-class markers — all failed against live bytes, the first because live G12 v4 has no namedCorpusClasses object for the catalog to leave behind.
